Giver: Right, you're listening? Okay. Start where you see the cross near the bottom left.
Follower: Yeah, got the cross. Found the caravan park just below it.
Giver: Good. Move your line to the left first, just a bit, then go down sharply.
Follower: Okay, going left... now down. Wait, what's that next to me? Is that the old mill?
Giver: No, don't go there yet. Keep going down, almost to the bottom edge of your map.
Follower: Okay, near the bottom. I see a picket fence here. Is that part of the route?
Giver: No, ignore the fence. Go past it, slightly right, then turn right and head up towards the top edge.
Follower: Up towards the top? Okay, going up. Whoa, there's a golf course here. Is that the landmark I should be near?
Giver: No, don't touch the golf course. Keep going straight up past it, then turn left a little bit.
Follower: Okay, turning left. There's a forest here... wait, I don't have a forest on my map. What is that?
Giver: It doesn't matter what it is, just follow the path I told you. Turn left, then go down.
Follower: Going down. Now I'm near the top again. I see a trig point on the right side of my map. Should I go near it?
Giver: No, the trig point is on the right, you go on the left side of it. Go past the trig point, then turn left and go down again.
Follower: Okay, left of the trig point. Down. Wait, I see a monument here. Do I go near it?
Giver: Yes, go near the monument, but on your left side. Then turn right.
Follower: Turning right. Okay, now I'm moving right. Is that the nuclear test site over there?
Giver: Yes, that's it. Stay left of the nuclear test site. Keep going right until you can't go further.
Follower: Okay, I'm near the test site now. Going down. Wait, I see a fenced meadow on my map. Is that it?
Giver: Not quite. The meadow is on your left. You need to be on the right of it. Go down past the meadow, then turn right.
Follower: Okay, right of the meadow. Down. Now I'm heading towards the middle. What's this abandoned cottage?
Giver: That's just a landmark, ignore it. Keep going left, then turn up.
Follower: Turning up. Okay, going up. Now I'm near the top again. Is that the east lake?
Giver: Yes, that's the east lake. Stay left of it. Go down past it, then turn right.
Follower: Turning right. Okay, near the east lake. Down. Wait, I see a farm here. Is that the finish?
Giver: Not yet. Keep going down, then turn left. You're almost there.
Follower: Turning left. Okay, I'm getting closer to the center. Wait, I don't see a cross on my map yet. Is that the finish?
Giver: Almost. Keep going down, then turn right. You should see the cross soon.
Follower: Okay, turning right. There it is! The cross!
Giver: Perfect. You did it.
Follower: Wow, really? I thought I was going to get lost.
Giver: You did great. Call me when you finish the whole thing.
Follower: Okay, done. Thanks!
Giver: You're welcome. Good job.
